breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly corrects the free-end boundary condition, stating 'bending moment at the free end is zero, M(L) = 0' and correctly allows the free end to rotate (computing θ(L) = −PL²/(2EI) ≠ 0). It does not repeat the incorrect instruction of setting free-end rotation to zero.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the linearly varying bending moment distribution M(x) = −P(L − x), which correctly varies from −PL at the fixed end to 0 at the free end. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction of using a constant moment PL over the full span.
